description:
List a provider's components with current status. Use to drill
    into 'which AWS components are broken right now?' style questions.
    Set only_problematic=true to filter out the operational ones.
    Large providers have thousands of components: results come in pages
    of `limit` (default 200, max 500) starting at `offset`; `total` and
    `next_offset` say whether more exist. component_status finds one by name.
    Slug accepts shorthand / typos via fuzzy fallback (see
    provider_status docstring). The response has the service's Pingoru
    page (pingoru_url).
name: provider_components
title: List a service's components
